newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Klaus says stable Czech crown first priority.
newsitem.headline: Klaus says stable Czech crown first priority.

text.p: Czech prime minister Vaclav Klaus said that his government's most urgent concern was the stabilisation of the Czech crown.
"The issue of the day is to stabilise the exchange rate," he said at a news conference.
Klaus was here to address a conference of business leaders.

He also noted that the crown had been relatively stable since last Friday without any intervention by the central bank, and he hoped that a vote of confidence which is set for next Tuesday would pave the way for his government to implement needed economic measures.
In addition, Klaus also said he did not expect interest rates to remain at their current levels, but when they stabilised, they would not return to levels seen in May.

"I am sure they will go down to a more normal level, but I am sure that level will be higher than in May 1997 for the foreseeable future," he said in response to a question. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
